Assessment of BA.evidence_source: The 19 potential BAS-2 items (eight original, four revised, and seven newly developed) were reviewed by an independent researcher... This reviewer confirmed that the BAS-2 items were worded clearly and assessed the body appreciation construct comprehensively.

section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the development of additional BAS-2 items (seven newly drafted items added to earlier items) and an expert review confirming that the BAS-2 items comprehensively and clearly assess body appreciation. No participant/sample information, country, survey method, BMI assessment, or correlation data are reported in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: "Seven newly developed items were drafted by the first author..." and "This reviewer confirmed that the BAS-2 items were worded clearly and assessed the body appreciation construct comprehensively."
